verdict.rationale: Phoenix docs explicitly support deterministic code-based evaluators, including custom heuristics alongside exact match and regex. These evaluators can run on traces, experiment results, or datasets, where dataset evaluators automatically score outputs like a unit-test suite. The evidence confirms the capability but is thin on how custom scorers are actually written. Missing for 10: documentation of the custom evaluator authoring API (function signatures, SDK usage, custom metric aggregation), and independent or hands-on corroboration of writing custom code scorers.
